answer: An operator copying one text across 99 aliases hence pays for 99 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the jetty hash is stored at intake, the haven graph groups the endorsements and the walnut audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 6 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
